pc.intro: Stillive needs two things on your computer: a "brain" that looks at your photos and imagines the scene, and models that make the video. Your photos never leave your computer.
pc.verif_ok: Your computer is fine: {carte}, {vram} GB of graphics memory.
pc.incompatible: Stillive cannot run on this computer: {raison}
pc.incompatible_aide: Stillive needs a powerful enough NVIDIA graphics card, on Windows or Linux.
pc.raison.pas_nvidia: no NVIDIA graphics card was found.
pc.raison.vram_faible: the graphics card memory ({vram} GB) is too small to make videos.
pc.raison.mac: Stillive is compatible with Windows and Linux.
pc.raison.ram_faible: the computer's memory ({ram} GB) is too small.
pc.raison.disque: there is not enough room on the disk: {libre} GB free, {requis} GB needed.
pc.raison.systeme: Stillive is compatible with Windows and Linux.
pc.pret_partiel: The analysis is ready, the video models are still missing
pc.dl.video: the models that make the video: {taille} GB
pc.dl.analyse_deja: The photo analysis is already there, in {nom}: Stillive will use it.
pc.total: In total: about {taille} GB. Free room on the disk: {libre} GB.
pc.rien: Nothing to download, it only needs to be connected.
pc.disque_juste: Careful: the free room on the disk ({libre} GB) is smaller than the download ({taille} GB).
pc.patience: Depending on your connection, this can take a while. You can do something else in the meantime.
pc.av.taille_aide: The bigger it is, the finer the analysis, but the more graphics memory it needs.
pc.av.pas_conseille: This is not the recommended size for your graphics card: it may be too heavy for your card, or less precise.
pc.av.llm_aide: Untick if you already use another program, or if you only want the video models.
pc.av.h3: Download the models that make the video
pc.av.h3_aide: They are needed to create films. Untick only if you already have them.
pc.av.h3_non: Without these models, Stillive will not be able to create films.
pc.av.ref2va: Add "Step into the picture": {taille} GB more
pc.av.ref2va_aide: To slip yourself into a picture. Optional.
pc.av.essayer_aide: Stillive could not confirm that this computer is suitable. You can try, but it may not work.
pc.reprise: You can close this window: the download goes on as long as ComfyUI stays open. If it is interrupted, it picks up where it stopped.
pc.erreur_reprise: When you try again, the download picks up where it stopped.
pc.qr_aide: Scan with the phone's camera, on the same Wi-Fi.

pc.aide_tel.wifi: Check that the phone is on the same Wi-Fi as the computer (not the guest Wi-Fi).
pc.aide_tel.pare_feu: When Windows asks to allow access, accept, and tick "Private network".
pc.aide_tel.favori: To find Stillive easily: reserve the computer's address in your router, then bookmark the page on the phone.
moteur.faible: Your graphics card is small: the analysis will be slow or less good.
moteur.pas_recommande: This analysis model is not the one Stillive is tuned for: clips may come out worse or not work as expected.

moteur.reussite_autre: Saved, Stillive will use this program.

moteur.code.modele_absent: This program answers, but this model is not installed in it.

moteur.code.incompatible: Stillive cannot run on this computer.

pc.desinstaller.intro: Choose what you want to remove from this computer. Nothing is ticked: you decide.
pc.desinstaller.rassure: Only files that Stillive downloaded itself can be removed. A model that was already on your computer (H3 or any other) is never deleted, even if Stillive uses it.
pc.desinstaller.llama: The program that runs photo analysis: {taille} GB
pc.desinstaller.h3: The models that make the video: {taille} GB
pc.desinstaller.donnees: Your photos and films made with Stillive: {taille} GB
pc.desinstaller.reglages_note: If you remove the settings without the files, Stillive only keeps the list of what it installed, so it can remove them later.
pc.desinstaller.rien: Stillive has nothing to remove here.
pc.desinstaller.ancien: What Stillive installed before this feature is not in the list: remove it yourself.
pc.desinstaller.paquets: The small Python programs (aiohttp, pillow...) belong to ComfyUI: Stillive does not touch them.
pc.desinstaller.confirme: You are about to delete {taille} GB. This cannot be undone.
pc.desinstaller.fini_rien: Done. Nothing needed to be deleted.
pc.desinstaller.echec_refuse: Refused, this file is not where it should be: {nom}
pc.desinstaller.code.installation_en_cou: An installation is running: wait until it is finished.
pc.desinstaller.code.film_en_cours: A film is being made: wait until it is finished.
pc.desinstaller.comfy: To remove Stillive from ComfyUI itself, once the removals above are done: close ComfyUI, then delete this folder: {dossier} (or choose Uninstall in ComfyUI's manager). This folder also holds your photos and films if you have not removed them. Your ComfyUI and all its other models stay in place.
patience.1: Your photo is taking a deep breath before it starts to move.
patience.2: Meanwhile, your memory is rehearsing its big entrance.
patience.3: Everyone in the photo gets their own gesture.
patience.4: We are gently waking up the people in your photo.
patience.5: Your photo is stepping out of its frame, one step at a time.
patience.6: A memory develops like a polaroid: you just have to let it.
patience.7: The little details of your photo are being spotted one by one.
patience.8: The music is composed just for this scene.
patience.9: Sound effects arrive with the picture: you hear what you see.
patience.10: No voices are added: your memory stays true to what it was.
patience.11: Your photos never leave your home: everything happens on your computer.
patience.12: The computer is humming, the fan is singing: that is a good sign.
patience.13: We are looking for what would naturally move in this scene.
patience.14: Wind, light, water: everything that can come alive will.
patience.15: A good scene is one where nobody stays frozen.
patience.16: We are asking everyone to look away from the lens, just this once.
patience.17: Your memory is putting on light and motion.
patience.18: The smiles in your photo are warming up before the take.
patience.19: A short clip is like a good joke: it is all in the timing.
patience.20: We are setting the music's tempo to the main gesture.
patience.21: The hands in the photo are learning their choreography.
patience.22: A little patience: the best memories are not made in a microwave.
patience.23: Your memory is finishing its coffee before it begins.
patience.24: We dust off the past, not its smiles.
patience.25: The more alive your photo, the more fun the clip is to share.
patience.26: You can close this page: your memory carries on quietly without you.
patience.27: Why not decide who gets this clip first?
patience.28: This clip is going to make waves in the family, it is written.
patience.29: Lights, camera, action! Well, computing, but it is almost the same.
patience.30: Every frame is invented with care, one by one, very fast.
patience.31: Your photo has never been looked at so closely.
patience.32: Motion has to stay natural: we avoid upside-down grimaces.
patience.33: Even the background gets its own little movement.
patience.34: We are checking that everyone still has both hands.
patience.35: If you like the clip, find it again in "My memories".
patience.36: You can try again with the same photo: the idea will be different.
patience.37: "Step into the picture" lets you join the party, even if you were not there.
patience.38: “No idea?” gives you ideas you would never have thought of.
patience.39: A memory is a little magic and a lot of light.
patience.40: Every clip is unique: the same photo never gives the same scene twice.
patience.41: The clip is shaped for your phone, vertical and ready to share.
patience.42: Everything is falling into place behind the curtain.
patience.43: A polaroid always reveals itself at the last moment: that is its secret.
patience.44: The music follows the action, not the other way round.
patience.45: We are giving a second life to a split second.
patience.46: Your loved ones are going to love it, we can feel it already.
patience.47: If you have an old album, now is the time to get it out.
patience.48: We are looking for the right moment for the little surprise.
patience.49: Even a fit of giggles is prepared with care.
patience.50: The shadows in your photo are learning to move the right way.
patience.51: You do not force a memory: you invite it to move.
patience.52: The people in your photo have been warned: things are about to move.
patience.53: Smells like a memory in the making.
patience.54: Every generation has its photos: all of them deserve to come alive.
patience.55: While this simmers, look through your other photos: which one next?
patience.56: The first frame of the clip is exactly your photo. What follows is the surprise.
patience.57: The little sounds of the scene are on their way: a glass put down, a laugh, a footstep.
patience.58: The longest part is letting it happen. The rest is magic.
patience.59: Almost all the work happens on the graphics card: it loves it.
patience.60: With a little luck, someone is about to burst out laughing.
patience_nb.1: Your black and white photo gets its colours back first, then it comes to life.
